text: Men are disturbed, not by things, but by the principles and notions which they form concerning things.
author: Epictetus
visual_brief: A technical optical diagram in the style of a physics patent, showing parallel incident light rays passing through an asymmetrical glass prism and refracting into a wide fan of altered trajectories, with dashed normal lines and construction arcs marking angles of incidence.
alt: Technical ray tracing diagram of light bending through an asymmetrical prism
